name: Jezebel
summary: The daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians and wife of King Ahab. She killed the prophets of the LORD, threatened Elijah, and had Naboth stoned for his vineyard.

key_moments.title: Killing the Prophets
key_moments.description: Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD. But Obadiah hid a hundred of them in caves and fed them with bread and water.

key_moments.title: A Threat Against Elijah
key_moments.description: When Ahab told her that Elijah had killed the prophets of Baal, Jezebel sent a messenger swearing to take Elijah's life by the next day. Elijah fled for his life.

key_moments.title: Naboth's Vineyard
key_moments.description: Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab's name telling the elders to have false witnesses accuse Naboth. Naboth was stoned, and Jezebel told Ahab to go and take the vineyard.

key_moments.title: Thrown from the Window
key_moments.description: When Jehu came to Jezreel, Jezebel painted her face and looked out a window. At Jehu's word she was thrown down and killed, just as the LORD had said through Elijah.
